activity-date.narrative: Outcome 1: Increased capacity and expertise across the Government of the Solomon Islands and partner organisations providing decision makers with the necessary tools to improve the sustainable management of marine resources. Outcome 2: Enhancing and integrating monitoring towards effective sustainable management of the marine environment. Outcome 3: Improved policies, plans and management of human activities in the marine environment at national, sub-national and community levels. Outcome 4: Increased national capability and capacity to respond to marine environmental emergencies. Outcome 5: Stakeholders-particularly local communities are empowered to actively participate in sustainable management of the marine environment.

description.narrative: Solomon Islands Turtle Monitoring: OUTPUT 2: Policy and regulatory recommendations proposed and guidelines developed.
